parity_exclusions: manifest_sha256 (source identity changed in previous integration work)

protocol.clock_mapping: Known constant offsets only; no estimated drift or hardware clock sync.
protocol.acceptance: All explicit checks in report; height/maneuver errors descriptive, no flight qualification.
protocol.ordering: local revoke/reset, watchdog poll, sensor send, link delivery, Pi completion, receiver selection, physics
protocol.link: Two seeded datagram queues; service every 4 ms; no retries.

pi_compute.evaluation: Control tick and sensor age validation at completion; polled every 4 ms.
pi_compute.limitation: Fixed service-time assumption, not measured Pi latency; no serialization or OS jitter.

protocol.fallback: Sensor-only local altitude hold plus flow damping; simulation reference, not G4/ESP firmware.
